description: This file contains implementation of Google Mock matchers, including classes and functions for matching strings, managing bipartite graph matchings, and describing matchers. It is part of the Google Mock testing framework, specifically for defining and handling matchers in C++ tests.

classes.name: MaxBipartiteMatchState
classes.description: Helper class implementing the Ford-Fulkerson max bipartite matching algorithm using implicit flow and residual graphs.

methods.name: Compute
methods.description: Calculates maximum bipartite matching and returns pairs of matched elements.

methods.name: TryAugment
methods.description: Performs depth-first search to find augmenting paths for flow in the bipartite graph.
